hypothesis.direction: Long if leader and laggard both close above first-30-minute range; short if both close below.
hypothesis.hypothesis_name: Cross-index leader escape followed by laggard continuation
hypothesis.invalidation: Leader closes back inside its opening range before confirmation.
hypothesis.known_prior_research: Distinct from single-symbol ORB/retest because identity requires cross-index lead-lag sequencing.
hypothesis.legal_entry_timestamp: Next completed one-minute timestamp after cross-index confirmation.
hypothesis.material_distinction_from_prior_work: The causal object is market-wide transmission, not a standalone breakout.
hypothesis.negative_expectation_falsifier: Lag confirmation fails WFA/control separation or leader-only control matches it.
hypothesis.participants_or_behavior: Index arbitrage, basket hedging, and sector/index rotation transmit directional pressure across NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, and SENSEX.
hypothesis.persistence_rationale: Cross-index confirmation filters idiosyncratic noise and captures broad index-flow alignment.
hypothesis.primary_outcome: Equal-weight direction-normalized underlying return across confirmed symbols to +45 completed minutes.
hypothesis.required_data: Synchronized one-minute underlying OHLC for all three indices.
setup_state_machine: WAIT first 30 completed bars for all symbols
IDENTIFY first index to close outside its opening range
WAIT up to 15 minutes for second index confirmation same direction
EMIT on confirming laggard and optionally evaluate all aligned symbols
hypothesis.single_emission_rule: At most one market-wide candidate per session.
hypothesis.structural_premise: When one index escapes its opening balance and another confirms with lag, broad-market flow is more durable than single-index noise.
